_comment: Example query derivation for a 120s vertical AI-news explainer ('GPT-6 Astra 体检报告'). Each key is a storyboard frame; each value is 2-4 concrete filmable queries. History beats get era-qualified archival queries (archive.org); emotional beats get modern stock (pexels/pixabay).
usage: python scripts/footage_scout.py search --queries-file examples/scene-queries.example.json --providers pexels,pixabay,archive --orientation portrait --out scout-example

frame1-anxiety-hook: woman staring at laptop worried late night
office worker anxious computer screen closeup
frame2-end-to-end-work: hands typing keyboard multiple screens code
developer working terminal screens modern office
frame3-benchmark-jump: data center server racks blue lights
